title: Psychological outcomes from a citizen science study on microplastics from household clothes washing
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2025, 4,1079-1093
DOI: 10.1039/D5VA00037H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Cameron Brick, Anna Bosshard, Bernou Boven, Julia Hijink, Antonia Praetorius, Lies Jacobs
Washing clothes releases microfibers, but people lack tools to reduce this pollution. This field study uses citizen science to identify behavior change targets and test learning through participation.
